page.overview:
Who is Chancellor?

The Chancellor is a Toad character who appears in Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars. He is the advisor to Princess Toadstool of the Mushroom Kingdom, a role that would be taken over by Toadsworth in later games.

The Chancellor is a Toad with green spots on his head. He also has a brown mustache and wears a green jacket.

The Chancellor will give Mario the World Map allowing him to view other places. Later in the game, the Chancellor refuses to let Princess Toadstool leave due to her being kidnapped by Bowser earlier. This is due to his over-protectiveness of the princess.
